claims.text: Pneumococcal vaccine: all RMD pts on immunosuppressants.
claims.quote: pneumococcal vaccination should be administered to all RMD patients taking immunosuppressive medication
claims.locator: Bass AR, et al. 2022 American College of Rheumatology Guideline for Vaccinations in Patients With Rheumatic and Musculoskeletal Diseases. Arthritis Care Res 2023;75(3):449-464

claims.text: Recombinant zoster vaccine: RMD pts >18 yrs on immunosuppressants.
claims.quote: recombinant zoster vaccination is recommended for RMD patients >18 years of age taking immunosuppressive medication
claims.locator: Bass AR, et al. 2022 American College of Rheumatology Guideline for Vaccinations in Patients With Rheumatic and Musculoskeletal Diseases. Arthritis Care Res 2023;75(3):449-464
